Paper-mode runs (when toggled) emitted no typed PaperExecutionLedgerEntry mirror, no typed ReplayBacktestStep, no typed ReplayBacktestSummary, no typed PaperModeFlag, no typed lineage rows, and no offline-inspectable evidence trio. Phase 2N records this paper-mode evidence gap as the second post-consolidation lane A typed mirror evidence-collection artifact: a deterministic five-scenario evidence pack (BTCUSDT long allow x3, ETHUSDT short allow x3, SOLUSDT orchestrator-held deny x2, LABUSDT orchestrator-abstained deny x2, BTCUSDT default-deny x2) and a pure-function harness driving the existing PaperModeRuntime and ReplayBacktestRunner composition roots end-to-end. Phase 2N does not introduce a paper-mode strategy, paper-mode trader process, paper-mode background loop, paper-mode scheduler, paper-mode FastAPI surface, paper-mode Redis adapter, paper-mode GPU runner, or paper-mode model-loading subsystem. Phase 2N produces typed evidence rows that subsequent shadow-mode evidence-collection, decision-explainability UI, and risk-gateway-extension milestones can read offline as a regression baseline. The richer paper-mode runtime modelling (multi-scenario PnL attribution, drawdown / win-loss bucket aggregation, per-confidence-bucket performance, paper trader process, paper executor) belongs to separate, later milestones explicitly out of scope at Phase 2N.
